title: api-gateway audit export: the spec declares from and to as ^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$ (required) but the route only checks new Date(x) - 7 of 9 tried values answer 200 (gate 202 G202-N3, Minor)
description:
**BLUF:** `services/api-gateway/src/api-gateway.openapi.ts` lines 629 and 630 declare `from` and `to` of `GET /api/admin/audit/export` as `z.string().regex(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/)` (described as required plain YYYY-MM-DD UTC dates), but the route's `formatDate` (`services/api-gateway/src/routes/audit-export.ts` lines 99 to 106) only calls `new Date(dateStr)` and rejects NaN. On gate 202's stub nine values were tried: seven answered 200 (`0`, `1`, `-1`, `2026-9-1`, `Sep 1 2026`, `2026-09-01T00:00:00Z`, and `2026-02-30`, which matches the pattern and rolls over) and two answered 400 (`20260901`, `x`). The base behaved the same, so the verdict calls this not a regression; the PR rewrote the declared constraint. Gate 202 grades this Minor.

Source: `/Volumes/DevMASTER/WEDNESDAY/0_Brain/reference/2026-11-05_gate202-ks1645-pr2012/verdict.md` lines 18 and 42 (G202-N3); `/Volumes/DevMASTER/WEDNESDAY/0_Brain/reference/2026-11-05_gate202-ks1645-pr2012/ev_pattern.out`. Code read by the filing seat at develop `1b1b65c7415f` with `git show` of that commit from the shared object store (a read), not run.

As read at `1b1b65c7415f`:

* `services/api-gateway/src/api-gateway.openapi.ts` lines 629 and 630: the two `z.string().regex(...)` declarations above (the verdict cites lines 630 and 631 at the PR head).
* `services/api-gateway/src/routes/audit-export.ts` lines 99 to 106: `const date = new Date(dateStr); if (isNaN(date.getTime())) { throw ... }; return date.toISOString().split('T')[0];`. A text search of that file at the tip for a regular-expression check finds none (control: the search finds `formatDate` 3 times).
* Verdict line 42 records the Schemathesis effect as predicted, not run: `negative_data_rejection` is active in `systemTest/schemathesis/config/checks.py` (READ ONLY).
* KS-1645 (the PR's own ticket, read whole) does not name this.

Not measured: anything by the filing seat; whether a Schemathesis run reports it; the nine values against the real route or a live stack.

Priority: Low, mapped from the verdict's grade Minor (verdict line 18).

nodes.title: Refs KS-2015: GET /api/admin/audit/export accepts only a real plain YYYY-MM-DD date for from and to, and answers 400 otherwise

nodes.body:
**BLUF:** PR 2169 (head `3521d7889c93`, one commit on develop `b602c418296a`) raises piece 1 of this ticket: the audit export route's `formatDate` now accepts only a real plain `YYYY-MM-DD` date. This is a LIVE admin API change: `GET /api/admin/audit/export` will answer 400 for `from` or `to` values that answered 200 before, among them the seven values listed in this ticket (`0`, `1`, `-1`, `2026-9-1`, `Sep 1 2026`, `2026-09-01T00:00:00Z`, `2026-02-30`). Product bytes change; tier 2 by Wednesday's stamp ruling, the gate may raise it. Nothing is merged or deployed, and this ticket stays open (the PR says Refs).

- **Measured by this seat:** the api-gateway suite reads 1,886 of 1,886 on develop and 1,897 of 1,897 with the patch; with the product put back, 8 of the 11 new cells fail.
- **Callers:** none found in the frontends, other services or the Extranet by search (a control hit the gateway); the admin frontend's export button calls a different route, `/api/security/audit/export`. Callers outside the repo are UNMEASURED.
- **Not in this PR:** the OpenAPI declaration (`api-gateway.openapi.ts` lines 629 and 630).
